input: During cold boot on a new board bring-up, the ADIv6 debug link between my external JTAG probe and the CoreSight SoC-600 DAP times out at the JTAG-DP IDCODE read phase. The SWD clock is 10 MHz, power-on-reset has de-asserted, and VDDIO is stable at 1.8 V. The timeout occurs consistently at DPIDR read before the CTRL/STAT power-up request. What is the most likely cause — APBDP not powered, incorrect JTAG pin-mux on the SoC, or a TRST# assertion issue — and what SWD/JTAG sequence should I use to isolate the root cause without a working debug session?
